purpose: Integrity pin of the three ratified constitutional documents. Repository transcriptions are identical to the ratified originals relative to this pin; any change to a pinned file breaks its digest and is a constitutional event requiring the amendment pathway (Implementation Constitution 11.2-11.3). Authority: Foundation Amendment F-001 (canonical authority completion) and F-002 (Snapshot Authority).

verification.semantics: Recompute sha256 of every pinned path and compare to this manifest. Any mismatch is a ConstitutionalViolationError (rule: F-001/SNAPSHOT). This manifest records the ratified originals' digests at transcription time and is therefore the binding identity proof between the ratified texts and the repository copies.
